title: Repeated synonym/antonym glossary gaps — nine Cambridge-sourced lookup terms
editorialStatus: provisional additions; independent lexical review pending
sourcePolicy: Vietnamese glosses and concise English definitions are paraphrased from linked Cambridge Dictionary entries. Each selected term occurs at least twice in canonical synonym/antonym references. Glossary-only change; existing headwords, relationships and learner data are unchanged.
